items.title: 9.5.1 Ka aur kamzor acid ki molar concentration se H3O+ ions ka hisab (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.5.1 with Sample 9.3, printed pages 196-197.

blocks.text: Kamzor acids pani mein poori tarah dissociate nahi hote, to hydronium ion ki concentration acid ki ibtidai concentration ke barabar nahi hoti; is ke bajaye equilibrium expression istemal hoti hai. Kamzor acid HA ke liye dissociation HA(aq) se H+(aq) + A-(aq) hai, aur pani mein H+ pani se mil kar H3O+ banata hai, to H3O+ ke lihaz se equilibrium HA(aq) se H3O+(aq) + A-(aq) hai. HA ki ibtidai concentration C mol dm-3 maan lein. Equilibrium par [H3O+] = x, [A-] = x aur [HA] = C - x, to Ka = [H3O+][A-] / [HA] = x^2 / (C - x). Kamzor acids ke liye x aam taur par C ke muqable bohat chhota hai, to C - x taqreeban C aur expression Ka = x^2 / C ban jati hai. Dono taraf ka square root lene se x = (Ka x C) ka square root, to H3O+ ki concentration (Ka C) ka square root hai.

blocks.caption: Kamzor acid ka equilibrium tarteeb dena

blocks.text: 0.1 M acetic acid, Ka = 1.8 x 10^-5, mein [H3O+] nikalein. [H3O+] = (Ka C) ka square root = (1.8 x 10^-5 x 0.1) ka square root = (1.8 x 10^-6) ka square root = 1.34 x 10^-3 M. (Print hasil-e-zarb 0.18 x 10^-6 dikhati hai; yeh 1.8 x 10^-6 hai.) Hydronium concentration taqreeban 1.34 x 10^-3 mol dm-3 hai.

blocks.prompt: 0.1 M nitrous acid, Ka = 4 x 10^-4, mein [H3O+] nikalein, aur formic acid ka Ka nikalein agar 0.10 M HCOOH ka pH 2.38 ho (Quick Check 9.3a, b).
blocks.explanation: Nitrous acid: [H3O+] = (4 x 10^-4 x 0.1) ka square root = (4 x 10^-5) ka square root = 6.3 x 10^-3 mol dm-3 (C ka taqreeban 6 feesad, to andaza sirf moti si had tak theek hai). Formic acid: [H3O+] = 10^-2.38 = 4.2 x 10^-3 mol dm-3, to Ka = x^2 / (C - x) = (4.2 x 10^-3)^2 / (0.10 - 0.0042) = 1.76 x 10^-5 / 0.0958 = 1.8 x 10^-4.

items: Concentration C ke kamzor acid ke liye: [H3O+] = [A-] = x, [HA] = C - x, Ka = x^2 / (C - x) jo x^2 / C ban jata hai, to [H3O+] = (Ka C) ka square root.
Sample 9.3: 0.1 M acetic acid, Ka 1.8 x 10^-5, se [H3O+] = (1.8 x 10^-6) ka square root = 1.34 x 10^-3 mol dm-3.
